I has Clean Earth Solar install a 10kw system for me about a month back. It consisted of a swap-out of 4kw of very old panels and an old 'dumb' converter, to a brand new 10kw system supported by a 10kwh battery, and a smart Zappi car charger.     The CES guys immediately got that my primary driver (as stated in the RFI) was to power my new EV off the roof.  One other group failed to get this at all. and the other group proposed what I might call a Rolls Royce solution for a WV sized problem.The CES lead (John) did a site visit - which led to an upwards adjustment of their original quote. BUT that I am glad they did this... a professional approach.The install went very well, and was achieved in a very long word day.   The one minor quibble I have is that the system only becomes operational, and they can only connect up the Apps that let you control the system, at the very end of the install.  As a result I felt this stage was a bit 'rushed', as they wanted to get home after a very long day.  That said, anyone who reads this should council their installer that they need a proper intro to the Apps, as in reality they are your interface with the system.  I understand the installer focuses on the INSTALL, and getting it to work, BUT the end user (you!) need a good grounding in how to use the Apps.Finally... was it worth it?? Absolute yes!!!  So far my ev (77kwh battery) has been charged 100% off the roof. The 10kw house battery is generally filled by 10AM, so I am exporting several $ a day on most days to the grid.  When I look at AGL's on-line system usage, in some days I'm importing around 01.c of power, and making maybe $5 / day.To be honest, I am knocked out by what a success it is, as each fortnight it saves me $130 of petrol!  I figure the entire system will pay for itself inside 4.2 years.   So if you have an EV and good sun exposure, go for it!
